STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_03887_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_03887_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_03887 (
  input wire [21:0] addr,
  input wire [31:0] datain,
  input wire       req,
  input wire       write,
  output reg [31:0] dataout,
  output wire      ack,
  output wire      decode,
  output wire      interrupt,

  input wire       timedout,
  output reg       promdisable,

  input wire       clk,
  input wire       reset
);

  reg             unibus_nxm = 1'b0;
  reg             xbus_nxm = 1'b0;
  reg             clear_bus_status = 1'b0;
  reg             unibus_int = 1'b0;
  reg [7:0]       unibus_vector = 8'b0;
  reg             xbus_int = 1'b0;
  reg             unibus_int_en = 1'b0;
  reg             clear_unibus_int_en = 1'b0;
  reg             set_unibus_int_en = 1'b0;
  reg             clear_bus_ints = 1'b0;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (timedout) begin
      if (addr > 22'o17400000)
        unibus_nxm <= 1'b1;
      else if (addr > 22'o17000000)
        xbus_nxm <= 1'b1;
    end else if (clear_bus_status) begin
      unibus_nxm <= 1'b0;
      xbus_nxm <= 1'b0;
    end
  end

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (clear_bus_ints) begin
      unibus_int <= 1'b0;
      unibus_vector <= 8'b0;
    end

    if (set_unibus_int_en)
      unibus_int_en <= 1'b1;

    if (clear_unibus_int_en)
      unibus_int_en <= 1'b0;
  end

  task bus_write;
    input [21:0] addr;
    begin
      case (addr)
        22'o17773005: begin
          if (datain[5] && datain[2] && ~datain[0])
            promdisable = 1;
        end
        22'o17773020: begin
          if (datain[10])
            set_unibus_int_en = 1;
          else
            clear_unibus_int_en = 1;
          clear_bus_ints = 1;
        end
        22'o17773022:
          clear_bus_status = 1;
      endcase
    end
  endtask

  task bus_read;
    input [21:0] addr;
    begin
      case (addr)
        22'o17773020:
          dataout = { 14'b0,
                      2'b0, unibus_int,
                      xbus_int, 2'b0,
                      1'b0, unibus_int_en, unibus_vector, 2'b0 };
        22'o17773022:
          dataout = { 28'b0, unibus_nxm, 2'b0, xbus_nxm };
      endcase
    end
  endtask

  wire in_unibus, decode_unibus;
  wire in_other, decode_other;

  assign in_unibus = ({addr[21:6], 6'b0} == 22'o17773000);
  assign decode_unibus = req & in_unibus;
  assign in_other = ({addr[21:6], 6'b0} == 22'o17777700) |
                    ({addr[21:12], 12'b0} == 22'o17740000);
  assign decode_other = req & in_other;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    promdisable = 0;
    clear_bus_status = 0;
    clear_bus_ints = 0;
    set_unibus_int_en = 0;
    clear_unibus_int_en = 0;
    dataout = 0;

    if (decode_unibus) begin
      if (write) begin
        bus_write(addr);
      end else begin
        bus_read(addr);
      end
    end

    if (decode_other)
      if (write) begin
        // Do nothing for other address space write
      end else begin
        dataout = 0;
      end
  end

  reg [1:0] ack_delayed = 0;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    ack_delayed[0] <= decode;
    ack_delayed[1] <= ack_delayed[0];
  end

  assign ack = ack_delayed[1];
  assign decode = decode_unibus || decode_other;
  assign interrupt = 0;

endmodule
